question: In a complete round of the citric acid cycle (or cycle of the ticarboxylic acids) we can observe that:

options.opb: Oxygen acts as a reactant of the catalysed reactions and dehydrogenases.
options.opc: ATP, acetyl-CoA, act as activators of the regulatory allosteric enzymes of the cycle.
options.opd: In four oxidation reactions catalyzed by dehydrogenases, 3 molecules of NAD + and one molecule of FAD are reduced.
